motion.name: landing-entry
motion.purpose: Full-fade bidirectional entry from an offscreen prepared pose; 75ms visual stagger capped at 180ms; 48px travel or 28px through 720px; static defaults and immediate accessible settlement.

motion.name: hero-entry
motion.purpose: Heading, description and action sequence with 90ms spacing; reverse visual order on upward reentry.

motion.name: landing-exit
motion.purpose: Fade and travel out through the outgoing 18% viewport edge; interrupted exits recover from their current pose over 320ms.

motion.name: workflow-sequence
motion.value: Above 720px: 2.4s (1.7s hold, 350ms ring, 350ms destination trace); through 720px: 1.2s (500ms hold, 700ms rail)
motion.purpose: Observe through Respond and wrap; clockwise radial slots, vertical mobile rows. Shared playback timeline suspends in place; interaction emphasis never changes playback. Independent of cube and demo.

motion.name: workflow-feedback
motion.purpose: Automatic tile remains highlighted alongside independent interaction emphasis. Focus overrides hover; keyboard and reduced-motion feedback are immediate. Mobile rail follows automatic stages only.

motion.name: cube-float
motion.purpose: Supplied local illustration; automatically pauses offscreen/hidden, static with reduced motion or no JavaScript.

motion.name: cube-pulse
motion.purpose: Edges, nodes and core use their source easing.

motion.name: cube-bottom-halo
motion.purpose: Lower-row propagation glow peaks at 1.74s; silhouette-masked behind floating faces with fill-box centered scaling. Inner core motion remains unchanged.

motion.name: demo-stage
motion.purpose: Three autoplay stages suspend on visibility loss.

motion.name: demo-hold
motion.purpose: Additional final review hold before restarting.

components.css: .ds-toggle { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; padding: 0; border: 1px solid var(--hairline-strong, rgb(172 190 209 / 42%)); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 12px); background: var(--surface-interactive, #111722); color: var(--text-primary, #f6f8fb); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms ease-out; } .ds-icon { position: relative; width: 24px; height: 24px; } .ds-line { position: absolute; top: 11px; left: 2px; width: 20px; height: 2px; background: currentColor; transition: transform 200ms ease-in-out, opacity 200ms ease-in-out; } .ds-line:first-child { transform: translateY(-6px); } .ds-line:last-child { transform: translateY(6px); } .ds-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] .ds-line:first-child { transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] .ds-line:nth-child(2) { opacity: 0; } .ds-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] .ds-line:last-child { transform: rotate(-45deg); } .ds-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--sentinel-steel, #acbed1); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-toggle:hover { background: var(--sentinel-navy, #1b3266); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-toggle, .ds-line { transition: none; } }

components.name: Industry card
components.description: Informational industry target; source desktop padding is responsive.
components.html:
01

Supermarkets and retail

Identify configured events related to product concealment, cash-to-pocket activity, cashier monitoring and people flow, then present them for review with visual context.
components.css: .ds-industry { padding: 24px; border: 1px solid #284254; border-radius: var(--radius-compact, 14px); background: #091623; color: var(--text-primary, #f6f8fb); font: 400 1rem/1.5 Roboto, sans-serif; transition: border-color 200ms, background-color 200ms; } .ds-number { display: block; color: var(--sentinel-steel, #acbed1); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; margin-bottom: 16px; } .ds-industry h3 { font-size: clamp(1.125rem, 1.35vw, 1.5rem); line-height: 1.25; margin: 20px 0 16px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-industry p { margin: 0; color: var(--sentinel-steel, #acbed1); line-height: 1.55; } @media (min-width: 1280px) { .ds-industry { padding: clamp(16px, calc(min(100vw, 1920px) * 0.012), 24px); } } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-industry:hover { border-color: #74b4d1; background: #0d1d2c; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-industry { transition: none; } }

components.name: FAQ disclosure
components.description: Native details/summary appearance and static interaction; production adds pointer-height animation.
components.html:
Do I need to buy new cameras?

Not necessarily. Sentinel can work with compatible existing camera systems. The site assessment confirms compatibility and identifies any changes required before deployment.
components.css: .ds-faq { color: var(--text-primary, #f6f8fb); font: 400 1rem/1.5 Roboto, sans-serif; border-top: 1px solid var(--hairline, #263447); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hairline, #263447); overflow: clip; } .ds-faq summary { box-sizing: border-box; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; min-height: 80px; padding: 22px 4px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; touch-action: manipulation; } .ds-faq summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-faq summary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--sentinel-steel, #acbed1); outline-offset: -4px; } .ds-plus { position: relative; flex: 0 0 32px; height: 32px; border: 1px solid var(--hairline-strong, rgb(172 190 209 / 42%)); border-radius: 50%; } .ds-plus::before, .ds-plus::after { content: ""; position: absolute; width: 12px; height: 1px; background: var(--sentinel-steel, #acbed1); top: 15px; left: 9px; transition: transform 200ms; } .ds-plus::after { transform: rotate(90deg); } .ds-faq[open] .ds-plus::after { transform: rotate(0); } .ds-answer { color: var(--sentinel-steel, #acbed1); padding: 0 48px 24px 4px; } .ds-answer p { margin: 0; line-height: 1.65; } @media (max-width: 720px) { .ds-faq summary { min-height: 88px; gap: 16px; } .ds-answer { padding-right: 4px; } } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-faq summary:hover { color: #8dd4ee; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-plus::before, .ds-plus::after { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview:
Sentinel uses dark photographic fields, clear white hierarchy, Roboto and restrained steel outlines to explain operational intelligence with composure. Generous commercial layouts let decision-makers understand the offer; illustrative cyan details show processing and review without implying live operational evidence.

The accepted landing is the baseline for extensions. Preserve supplied logo proportions, assets and copy. [PRODUCT](PRODUCT.md) owns product truth and unresolved commercial actions; [surface briefs](.impeccable/surfaces/src-app-page-tsx.md) own page strategy. This document records reusable visual decisions, not dashboard recipes.
keyCharacteristics: Dark navy scenes and legible photographic overlays.
Large balanced headings and measured body copy.
Bounded reference geometry with responsive reading order.
Restrained outlines and local cyan illustration detail.
Complete content with reduced motion or without JavaScript.
dos: Do preserve Roboto, supplied logo geometry, source assets and approved copy.
Do retain the centered reference frame, bounded capabilities exception and viewport-height hero.
Do keep keyboard focus visible and content complete with reduced motion or without JavaScript.
Do use cyan as local illustrative detail and keep deployment caveats readable.
donts: Don't introduce dashboard recipes or semantic alert colours as landing requirements.
Don't activate unavailable actions or invent destinations, legal terms or product claims.
Don't hide content behind motion or turn the separate demo's illustrative stage labels into controls.
Don't replace the accepted visual direction during a focused extension or correction.
